en.moment_body: Twenty-two goals across four tournaments — more than anyone who has ever played in one. Not a single moment but an accumulation: every final third, every half-yard of space, every year of arriving. Records fall. This one was built.

en.meta_description: Twenty-two goals across four tournaments, more than anyone before. IM-08 of the Iconic Series captures the all-time scoring record, in archive sketch format. 220 GSM premium cotton tee.
